description: Download and return the text content of a Box (cloud storage) file by its file id. Best for plain-text, Markdown, CSV, and other text documents; binary formats (Office docs, PDFs, images) will return unreadable bytes. Content is capped at ~100,000 characters and flagged when truncated.

file_id.description: The Box file id of the file to read.

name: box_get_file_text
title: Box Get File Text
